summary: Rebuild Trust from a bundle, like SSL_CERT_FILE from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Trust from a bundle, like SSL_CERT_FILE** in *Installing trust*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: A trust bundle is just PEM blocks one after another. What does this print?
code: var a = DojoCert("CN=Public Root A", null, true);
var b = DojoCert("CN=Public Root B", null, true);
var corp = DojoCert("CN=Corp Root CA", null, true);

string bundle = "# ca-certificates.crt
" + a.ExportCertificatePem() + "
" + b.ExportCertificatePem() + "
" + corp.ExportCertificatePem() + "
";
static X509Certificate2 DojoCert(string subject, X509Certificate2? issuer, bool isCa, string? dns = null, string? eku = null, int nbYear = 2030, int naYear = 2035)
var req = new CertificateRequest(subject, key, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
req.CertificateExtensions.Add(new X509KeyUsageExtension(isCa ? X509KeyUsageFlags.KeyCertSign | X509KeyUsageFlags.CrlSign : X509KeyUsageFlags.DigitalSignature, true));
if (dns != null) { var b = new SubjectAlternativeNameBuilder(); foreach (var d in dns.Split(',')) b.AddDnsName(d); req.CertificateExtensions.Add(b.Build()); }
if (eku != null) req.CertificateExtensions.Add(new X509EnhancedKeyUsageExtension(new OidCollection { new Oid(eku) }, false));
using var pub = req.Create(issuer, nb, na, serial);
steps.explain: That is all `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` is: `update-ca-certificates` concatenates every trusted root into one file.

prompt: Write `bool TrustsWithBundle(string bundlePem, X509Certificate2 leaf, X509Certificate2Collection intermediates)`: does a client whose trust store is the PEM bundle `bundlePem` (what `SSL_CERT_FILE` points at) accept `leaf`?
- load every certificate in the bundle as a trust anchor (`CustomRootTrust`)
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
bool TrustsWithBundle(string bundlePem, X509Certificate2 leaf, X509Certificate2Collection intermediates)
